gaps.title: Unexplored Application of Second on Nuscenes Dataset
gaps.description: While Second and Nuscenes Dataset are prominent in current literature, zero papers in the corpus have evaluated Second directly on Nuscenes Dataset under Adversarial Data-Poisoning Attacks constraints.
gaps.hypothesis: Applying Second directly to Nuscenes Dataset under Adversarial Data-Poisoning Attacks constraints will overcome the structural representation disconnect, achieving statistically significant error reduction over traditional baseline heuristics.

anchor_a.title: Seminal Formulation: Second
anchor_a.tldr: Introduces Second with strong empirical validation.

anchor_b.title: Empirical Evaluation on Nuscenes Dataset
anchor_b.tldr: Highlights persistent degradation under Adversarial Data-Poisoning Attacks.
